source.prompt: looking for ERP software that has HR payroll and CRM in one

answer.text:

Finding an all-in-one platform that natively handles ERP (operations/accounting), CRM, HR, and Payroll under a single roof can be tough, as most systems lean heavily into either front-office (CRM) or back-office/people ops (HR & Payroll).
The top ERP options that successfully combine all three include:
Odoo: Highly modular and famously known as a true all-in-one open-source/cloud ERP. You can install native apps for CRM, Sales, Inventory, Accounting, HR (timesheets, recruitment, appraisals), and Payroll, ensuring everything lives in a single database without clumsy third-party connectors.
ERPNext: A robust, open-source integrated ERP platform that features fully built-in CRM, comprehensive Human Resource management, attendance tracking, and localized payroll processing natively out-of-the-box.
Microsoft Dynamics 365: An enterprise-grade ecosystem where you can combine Dynamics 365 Sales (CRM) with Business Central or Finance & Operations (ERP), supplemented by native HR and payroll extensions. It requires more configuration, but everything is tightly unified under the Microsoft corporate umbrella.
Oracle NetSuite: A dominant cloud ERP that has robust built-in CRM capabilities alongside its SuitePeople module, which manages HR and global payroll operations inside the core financial suite. Best suited for mid-market to enterprise scales.
